email.subject1: a partner signal play for Seso
email.body1:
Caroline, saw Seso closed its $26M Series B led by BOND to expand the H-2A and ag-workforce platform.

Leading partnerships and growth, the hard part is partner-sourced coverage at scale: more in-market agribusiness and partner accounts than the team can activate before they cool. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Seso's partner ecosystem off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.subject2: drafts to your top partner targets
email.body2:
Caroline, quick follow-up for Seso.

Partner-led motions stall when target outreach is manual and slow, so the best joint accounts sit untouched while the team works the obvious ones. Speed and personalization at scale are where partner-sourced pipeline compounds, and most teams cannot run both at once without adding headcount.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to your top three partner-ecosystem targets. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through them?
email.body3:
Caroline, last bit of proof for Seso.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a pipeline gap analysis for your partner motion. Want to grab time so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Caroline, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling partner-sourced pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Expanding the platform post-raise is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page co-sell pilot playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your partner ecosystem? I will tailor it to Seso either way.
